source: User EURUSDz5.csv, broker M5 Bid OHLC, Feb-Oct2026
native_proxy: Frozen Market/Forecast candidate, not T+1/LOCK/tick eligibility/model/news/publication. Compare entry at anchor+300 versus anchor, same candidate.
new_features: Only64closed contiguous M5 bars before anchor; SMA20/50 exclude trigger, slow SMA slope over5bars; ATR14 arithmetic TR, priorATR excludes trigger; range levels prior24bars excluding trigger.
new_common_filter: 0<ATR14<=30pips, trigger range<=2.5*priorATR; no lower ATR floor; baseline native retains3pip floor
trend_pullback: SMA20>SMA50 and slowSlope>0; prior3bar net<0; trigger low<=SMA20+0.1priorATR, close>SMA20+0.05priorATR, positive body, close location>=0.6; mirror short.
range_rejection: abs(SMA20-SMA50)<=priorATR; trigger sweeps prior24low by>0.05priorATR and closes above it by>0.05priorATR, positive body/location>=0.6; mirror short.
breakout_momentum: SMA20>SMA50; trigger close>prior24high+0.1priorATR, positive body>=0.5range, close location>=0.75; mirror short.
parameter_search: NONE; five fixed full strategy contracts, no winner promotion

binary.entry: MT4 Bid bar open at planned entry, not Olymp fill
binary.expiry: next contiguous M5 bar Bid open, 5min reference; not exact platform expiry tick
binary.position_rule: one stake per5min per strategy; nonoverlapping entry-to-expiry intervals

forex.entry: long at BidOpen+fixedSpread, short at BidOpen; no lookahead fill
forex.stop: distance=max(1.5*signalATR,6pips); reject distance>30pips; not structural native stop
forex.exit_sides: long Bid OHLC; short reconstructed Ask OHLC=Bid+fixedSpread
forex.position_rule: one position per strategy/scenario; no new entry on a bar occupied at its open
forex.gap_open: adverse stop fill at observed open, favourable TP capped at target; missing M5 interval makes outcome UNAVAILABLE
forex.units: R based on fixed initial stop distance; no balance compounding/lot sizing

session_mapping: default brokerUTC0 provisional, pinned tzdata2026.4; also export offset+-60min label sensitivity; no session selection after outcomes
decision: All results remain unvalidated. Positive proxies require tick/BO-platform, costs, retrospective time splits and genuinely new forward evidence; no promotion on this known history. Zero trade session alone does not prove bad strategy.
